title: Your next coworker isn't human (AI agents v2: Grok Bot / Muse / Dots)
notes: say = what Piper reads (spelling tuned for Piper), show = on-screen caption. ' / ' in show marks a caption break. pause = silence after the line, seconds.

lines.say: It's cute. It's cuddly. And it wants your data.
lines.show: It's cute. It's cuddly. / And it wants your data.

lines.say: That's a real headline. About an AI agent.
lines.show: That's a real headline. / About an AI agent.

lines.say: The three biggest names in tech. Forty nine days. Same bet. And the cutest one is winning.
lines.show: The 3 biggest names in tech. 49 days. Same bet. / And the cutest one is winning.

lines.say: Day zero. Musk ships the Grok Bot. It keeps working with your laptop closed.
lines.show: Day 0. Musk ships Grok Bot. / It keeps working with your laptop closed.

lines.say: Day twenty eight. Meta ships Muse, starring a cuddly doll named Jolly.
lines.show: Day 28. Meta ships Muse, / starring a cuddly doll named Jolly.

lines.say: Zuckerberg even put it on a keychain.
lines.show: Zuckerberg even put it on a keychain.

lines.say: Day forty nine. Open AI launches Dots. Little bubbles you name yourself.
lines.show: Day 49. OpenAI launches Dots. / Little bubbles you name yourself.

lines.say: Why cute? Because you won't hand your inbox and your credit card to a robot.
lines.show: Why cute? / Because you won't hand your inbox / and your credit card to a robot.

lines.say: You'll hand them to a friend.
lines.show: You'll hand them / to a friend.

lines.say: And it won't stop at one. The Grok Bot has a bot that manages other bots.
lines.show: And it won't stop at one. / Grok Bot has a bot / that manages other bots.

lines.say: Open AI wants teams of Dots. And Meta? The Muse app, for small business.
lines.show: OpenAI wants teams of Dots. / And Meta? Muse for Small Business.

lines.say: Your next coworker? Not human. Probably adorable.
lines.show: Your next coworker? / Not human. Probably adorable.

lines.say: First, the score. The Muse app jumped above Chat G P T, to number one. Meta stock had its best month since twenty thirteen.
lines.show: First, the score. / The Muse app jumped above ChatGPT to #1. / Meta stock had its best month since 2013.

lines.say: The Grok Bot went from a three hundred dollar plan to thirty, in two weeks.
lines.show: Grok Bot went from a $300 plan / to $30, in two weeks.

lines.say: And your first Dot comes included with Pro.
lines.show: And your first Dot / comes included with Pro.

lines.say: Cute, cheap, or capable. Who wins? Comment below.
lines.show: Cute, cheap, or capable. / Who wins? Comment below.

sources.nbc_cute: NBC News, Angela Yang, Sep 24 2026 - 'It's cute. It's cuddly. And it wants your data.' (Jolly: cream-colored, beady black eyes, upward smile)
sources.grok_launch: x.ai/news/introducing-grok-bot - early beta Aug 11 2026 (SuperGrok Heavy $300/mo, Cursor Ultra, Cursor Teams Premium); Memeburn: works with laptop closed
sources.grok_price: Expanded Aug 21 and Aug 26 2026 to all SuperGrok ($30/mo) + Cursor Pro/Teams plans (blockchain.news, cellcog.ai, codersera)
sources.grok_chief: Bots delegate to other Bots; a 'chief of staff' bot manages specialist bots (beam.ai, superpowerdaily)
sources.muse_launch: Muse launched Sep 8 2026; overtook ChatGPT for #1 on Apple App Store (CNBC Sep 29, NBC)
sources.muse_charm: Engadget / Yahoo Tech - Muse Charm, keychain device; 'blend of a Labubu and a Tamagotchi'
sources.muse_smb: CNBC Sep 29 2026 - Meta launches Muse for Small Business (Shopify, Stripe, QuickBooks, Slack...)
sources.meta_stock: CNBC Sep 30 / Bloomberg Sep 24 2026 - Meta's best month since 2013 (exact % differs by source: 27-36%, so the reel states no %)
sources.dots: OpenAI DevDay Sep 29 2026 - Dots; 'Your dot' renameable; first dot included in Pro and Business Premium; teams of Dots coming (9to5google, Engadget, TechCrunch 'bubbly agentic avatar')
